conditional_findings.classification: New95e conditional aggregate numeric representability question connected to original059 scopes; not an observed runtime defect or new checkpoint3821 finding.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Relationship between the configured positive landing recovery duration, admitted compression range and finite HeightSpeed result at the owning configuration/height operation boundary.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: Strict positivity of a recovery divisor does not guarantee that an admitted nonzero compression divided by it is a finite f32 rate.
conditional_findings.trace: AnimationLandingConfig stores PositiveAnimationDuration, which rejects zero; the shown landing validator checks compression ordering and the shown top-level validation does not check recovery rate representability. landing_profile copies the duration into an AnimationElapsed, and begin_landing calls HeightSpeed::recovery after calculating the target compression. That operation rejects a nonfinite quotient. apply_locomotion_height logs and skips publishing the copied height state when advance_height returns an error. Server startup and client observer validate and install configuration snapshots.
conditional_findings.symbolic_example: For a finite positive duration 2^-140 seconds and compression 2^-5 metres, the exact quotient is 2^135 metres/second, exceeding the greatest finite binary32 value (<2^128). Both operands are representable binary32 values. The committed landing settings have a 0.04m minimum compression (>2^-5), minimum impact1.0m/s, and recovery0.16s; the example duration is not the committed one. This is exact symbolic arithmetic, not execution of the product, YAML parser, graphics or an allocated scene.
conditional_findings.safeguards: The zero-duration hypothesis is excluded on the traced configured path. A landing must have an earlier height observation, a nonzero in-budget sequence delta, no early quickstep or posture-transition bypass, an impact at least the threshold, and successful preceding calculations. No fully parsed/delivered extreme configuration, landing event, rejected frame or visual effect has been observed. Source-declared fallback and reset policy elsewhere may matter. Whether subnormal/extreme tuning is intended to be supported requires a policy decision.
dependencies: Establish the supported duration/compression ranges and all constructors, serialization and runtime consumer paths.
Resolve whether to reject unsupported relationships at configuration admission or use a defined bounded recovery method; retain zero elapsed for ordinary observations.
Reconcile historical059 queue842,847,1448 and exact aliases without relabeling their earlier read qualifications.
later_acceptance: Supported recovery settings yield a finite and meaningful derived operation for the allowed compression range; unsupported combinations fail at the owning boundary with useful context.
Preserve normal landing and no-extra-impairment gameplay behavior; later validation must be separately authorized.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; source-directed representability counterexample and rejection path connected, full config reachability, live landing and aliases open

conditional_findings.classification: New95e conditional field-specific configuration and settlement policy question; prior6533 signed-type and capped-caller qualifications remain intact.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: The inverse-kinematics settle_step_seconds field and the settlement transition using that field, not the general signed ResponseShapingTime type.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: The actual settlement consumer advances toward completion using a signed divisor, but the shown field validation does not define whether nonpositive values are intended modes or supported inputs.
conditional_findings.trace: ResponseShapingTime admits all finite signed values. InverseKinematicsConfig stores settle_step_seconds in that type, and the top-level IK validation has no reference to this field. Settlement planning seeds progress at zero; when a nonzero elapsed sample occurs, advance_settle_state uses this field in advance_settle. The kernel caps at1 and retains finite negative results. The IK loop uses is_complete for readiness; the swing-target helper clamps progress to0..1.
conditional_findings.symbolic_example: With a hypothetical field value -1 second, initial progress0 and a positive elapsed sample0.5 seconds, the shown arithmetic gives retained progress -0.5; the swing helper sees0 and the completion predicate is false. The shipped YAML uses +0.28 seconds. This is exact source-directed arithmetic only; no alternate configuration or animation was run.
conditional_findings.safeguards: The normal IK loop skips advancement for zero elapsed, and completion can also be requested by a safe-stance elapsed fallback or a terminal state; terminal contact preparation and rendered-contact checks still apply. Therefore the example does not prove permanent failure, a visible defect, or that negative tuning is unsupported. Original Segovb575 explicitly keeps signed shaping/progress intentional unless the actual configuration/native contract establishes otherwise, and rejects an above-one witness for this capped producer.
dependencies: Determine the supported configuration policy for zero and negative settlement time, and trace all installation, settle, foot contact and fallback lifecycles.
Decide whether this field requires a positive duration or whether defined signed/instant semantics should remain; do not globally narrow the shared shaping type.
Reconcile original059 queue1448/1455 and any exact aliases without revising earlier attribution.
later_acceptance: Each supported field value has defined settlement, contact and fallback behavior; unsupported values fail at the owning configuration boundary.
Preserve legitimate negative shaping modes in other consumers and normal positive settlement behavior; validation remains separately authorized.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; actual field, producer, consumer, symbolic signed case and fallback connected, policy and runtime reachability remain open
